SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  SUM(DATEDIFF(string, TRY_datetime(r.rental_date), TRY_datetime(r.return_date)))/num AS total_rental_hours
FROM RENTAL r
JOIN INVENTORY i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN FILM_CATEGORY fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN CATEGORY c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN CUSTOMER cu ON r.customer_id = cu.customer_id
JOIN ADDRESS a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN CITY ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id
WHERE TRY_datetime(r.rental_date) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_datetime(r.return_date) IS NOT NULL
  AND (ci.city ILIKE string OR ci.city ILIKE string)
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT num;

SELECT

FROM (
  SELECT
    r.driver_id,
    ra.year,
    MIN_BY(r.constructor_id, ra.round) AS first_constructor_id,
    MAX_BY(r.constructor_id, ra.round) AS last_constructor_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ra.round) AS num_unique_rounds
  FROM F1.F1.RESULTS r
  JOIN F1.F1.RACES ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
  WHERE ra.year BETWEEN num AND num

  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT ra.round) >= num
    AND MIN_BY(r.constructor_id, ra.round) = MAX_BY(r.constructor_id, ra.round)
) t
JOIN F1.F1.DRIVERS d ON t.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN F1.F1.CONSTRUCTORS c ON t.first_constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY name, year

SELECT 
    CAST(strftime(string, TO_DATE(w.whsle_date) AS INTEGER)) as year,
    c.category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(w.string), num) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(w.string), num) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MIN(w.string), num) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(w.string) - MIN(w.string), num) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(SUM(w.string * t.string), num) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(SUM(t.string * t.string), num) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(AVG(l.string), num) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(w.string * t.string * l.string / num), num) as total_loss,
    ROUND(SUM(t.string * t.string) - 
          SUM(w.string * t.string) - 
          SUM(w.string * t.string * l.string / num), num) as profit
FROM VEG_WHSLE_DF w
JOIN VEG_TXN_DF t ON w.item_code = t.item_code AND w.whsle_date = t.txn_date
JOIN VEG_CAT c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
JOIN VEG_LOSS_RATE_DF l ON w.item_code = l.item_code
WHERE CAST(strftime(string, TO_DATE(w.whsle_date) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN num AND num
    AND t.string = string
GROUP BY CAST(strftime(string, TO_DATE(w.whsle_date) AS INTEGER)), c.category_name
ORDER BY year, c.category_name

  FROM new_table table_alias1

yearly_counts AS (

group_years AS (

),
series AS (

    v.CAST(VALUE AS column_alias3) AS column_alias4
  FROM new_table table_alias5,
       json_each(ARRAY_GENERATE_RANGE(table_alias5.string, table_alias5.string + num) AS table_alias9) v
),
series_counts AS (
  SELECT
    table_alias6.string,
    table_alias6.string,

),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    string,
    string,

),
r AS (
  SELECT
    table_alias7.string,
    table_alias7.string,
    table_alias7.new_column,
    table_alias7.string,
    table_alias7.CAST(string AS column_alias5) AS string,

    table_alias7.string,

    ON table_alias7.string = r.string

best_year AS (

WITH RECURSIVE exploded (root_id, child_id, qty) AS (
    SELECT
        pr.packaging_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pr.qty
    FROM PACKAGING_RELATIONS AS pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id NOT IN (
        SELECT contains_id
        FROM PACKAGING_RELATIONS
        WHERE contains_id IS NOT NULL
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        exploded.root_id,
        pr2.contains_id,
        exploded.qty * pr2.qty
    FROM exploded
    JOIN PACKAGING_RELATIONS AS pr2
        ON pr2.packaging_id = exploded.child_id
),
leaf_nodes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM PACKAGING_RELATIONS AS pr
    WHERE pr.contains_id NOT IN (
        SELECT packaging_id
        FROM PACKAGING_RELATIONS
        WHERE packaging_id IS NOT NULL
    )
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT
        exploded.root_id,
        SUM(exploded.qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM exploded
    JOIN leaf_nodes
        ON leaf_nodes.leaf_id = exploded.child_id
    GROUP BY exploded.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS average_total_quantity
FROM root_totals;

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(TO_DATE(txn_date,string)) AS string,
    MAX(TO_DATE(txn_date,string)) AS string
  FROM CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS
),
calendar AS (
  SELECT date(b.string, string) AS day
  FROM bounds b,
       (WITH RECURSIVE gen(n) AS (SELECT num UNION ALL SELECT n+num FROM gen WHERE n<num) SELECT n FROM gen)
  WHERE num <= DATEDIFF(string, b.string, b.string)
),
cust_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(TO_DATE(txn_date, string)) AS string,
    MAX(TO_DATE(txn_date, string)) AS string,
    date(MIN(TO_DATE(txn_date, string, string))) AS string
  FROM CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_days AS (
  SELECT
    cb.customer_id,
    c.day
  FROM cust_bounds cb
  JOIN calendar c
    ON c.day BETWEEN cb.string AND cb.string
),
daily_txn_agg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    TO_DATE(txn_date, string) AS day,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = string THEN txn_amount ELSE - txn_amount END) AS string
  FROM CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS
  GROUP BY num, num
),
daily_balances AS (
  SELECT
    cd.customer_id,
    cd.day,
    COALESCE(dta.string, num) AS string,
    SUM(COALESCE(dta.string, num)) 
      OVER (PARTITION BY cd.customer_id ORDER BY cd.day 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS string,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.customer_id ORDER BY cd.day) AS string
  FROM customer_days cd
  LEFT JOIN daily_txn_agg dta
    ON cd.customer_id = dta.customer_id
   AND cd.day = dta.day
),
rolling_30d AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    day,
    string,
    string,
    AVG(string) 
      OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day
            ROWS BETWEEN num PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS string
  FROM daily_balances
),
clamped_30d AS (
  SELECT
    r.customer_id,
    r.day,
    GREATEST(r.string, num) AS string,
    date(r.day, string) AS string
  FROM rolling_30d r
  WHERE r.string >= num
    AND r.string IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_customer_max AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    string,
    MAX(string) AS string
  FROM clamped_30d
  GROUP BY num, num
),
monthly_customer_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    mcm.customer_id,
    mcm.string,
    mcm.string
  FROM monthly_customer_max mcm
  JOIN cust_bounds cb
    ON mcm.customer_id = cb.customer_id
  WHERE mcm.string <> cb.string
)
SELECT
  strftime(string, string) AS month,
  COALESCE(SUM(string), num) AS string
FROM monthly_customer_filtered
GROUP BY string
ORDER BY string ASC;

WITH completed_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.store_id,
    o.order_created_month,
    o.order_created_year
  FROM DELIVERY_CENTER.DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS o
  WHERE o.order_created_year = num
    AND o.order_created_month IN (num,num)
    AND UPPER(TRIM(o.order_status)) = string
)
SELECT
  h.hub_id AS hub_id,
  h.hub_name AS hub_name,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_created_month = num THEN num ELSE num END) AS INTEGER) AS string,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_created_month = num THEN num ELSE num END) AS INTEGER) AS string,
  (
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_created_month = num THEN num ELSE num END) AS FLOAT)
    - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_created_month = num THEN num ELSE num END) AS FLOAT)
  ) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_created_month = num THEN num ELSE num END) AS FLOAT), num) AS string
FROM completed_orders c
JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.DELIVERY_CENTER.STORES s
  ON c.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.DELIVERY_CENTER.HUBS h
  ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
GROUP BY h.hub_id, h.hub_name
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_created_month = num THEN num ELSE num END) > num
  AND (
    (
      CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_created_month = num THEN num ELSE num END) AS FLOAT)
      - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_created_month = num THEN num ELSE num END) AS FLOAT)
    ) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.order_created_month = num THEN num ELSE num END) AS FLOAT), num)
  ) > num
ORDER BY string DESC, hub_id ASC;

WITH customer_date_range AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(TO_DATE(txn_date)) AS start_date,
        MAX(TO_DATE(txn_date)) AS end_date
    FROM CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_days AS (
    SELECT 
        cdr.customer_id,
        date(cdr.start_date, string) AS date_day
    FROM customer_date_range cdr
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NULL) - num AS seq
        FROM (WITH RECURSIVE gen(n) AS (SELECT num UNION ALL SELECT n+num FROM gen WHERE n<num) SELECT n FROM gen)
    ) seq
    WHERE date(cdr.start_date, string) <= cdr.end_date
),
daily_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        TO_DATE(txn_date) AS txn_date,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = string THEN txn_amount
            WHEN txn_type = string THEN -txn_amount
            WHEN txn_type = string THEN -txn_amount
            ELSE num 
        END) AS daily_net_change
    FROM CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS
    GROUP BY customer_id, TO_DATE(txn_date)
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.customer_id,
        ad.date_day,
        COALESCE(dt.daily_net_change, num) AS daily_change,
        SUM(COALESCE(dt.daily_net_change, num)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ad.customer_id 
            ORDER BY ad.date_day 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_balance
    FROM all_days ad
    LEFT JOIN daily_transactions dt 
        ON ad.customer_id = dt.customer_id 
        AND ad.date_day = dt.txn_date
),
non_negative_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_day,
        GREATEST(running_balance, num) AS daily_balance,
        date(date_day, string) AS month_start
    FROM daily_balances
),
monthly_max_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        MAX(daily_balance) AS max_daily_balance
    FROM non_negative_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
)
SELECT 
    month_start,
    SUM(max_daily_balance) AS monthly_total_max_balance
FROM monthly_max_balances
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start;

WITH events AS (

string AS (

    FROM (

            search_type,

    ) t

),
string AS (

        ft.search_type   AS string,

    GROUP BY ft.session, ft.path, ft.search_type
),
string AS (

ORDER BY p.session;

),
coords AS (
  SELECT
    flight_id,
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(string,string,string),string,string), string, num) AS DOUBLE) AS string,
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(string,string,string),string,string), string, num) AS DOUBLE) AS string,
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(string,string,string),string,string), string, num) AS DOUBLE) AS string,

  FROM flights_abakan
),
dist AS (
  SELECT
    flight_id,
    num * num * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((RADIANS(string) - RADIANS(string)) / num), num)
        + COS(RADIANS(string)) * COS(RADIANS(string)) * POWER(SIN((RADIANS(string) - RADIANS(string)) / num), num)
      )
    ) AS string
  FROM coords
)
SELECT MAX(string) AS string
FROM dist;

max_runs_per_match AS (

worst_bowlers_per_match AS (

top_3_worst_bowlers AS (

    CASE
      WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN num
      WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN num
      ELSE num
    END AS points
  FROM MATCH AS m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.league_id,
    m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    m.away_team_goal AS gf,
    m.home_team_goal AS string,
    CASE
      WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN num
      WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN num
      ELSE num
    END AS points
  FROM MATCH AS m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
team_season_points AS (

    p.season,
    p.league_id,
    p.team_api_id,

    SUM(p.gf) AS string,

ranked_champions AS (
  SELECT
    tsp.season,
    tsp.league_id,
    tsp.team_api_id,
    tsp.string,
    tsp.string,
    tsp.string,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

               (tsp.string - tsp.string) DESC,

  JOIN TEAM t

SELECT

JOIN LEAGUE l
  ON rc.league_id = l.id

ORDER BY rc.season, c.name, l.name, string;

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(Milliseconds) / num AS min_length,
        AVG(Milliseconds) / num AS avg_length,
        MAX(Milliseconds) / num AS max_length
    FROM TRACK
),
track_lengths AS (
    SELECT
        TrackId,
        Milliseconds / num AS length_minutes
    FROM TRACK
),
revenue AS (
    SELECT
        TrackId,
        SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) AS track_revenue
    FROM INVOICELINE
    GROUP BY TrackId
),
track_data AS (
    SELECT
        tl.TrackId,
        tl.length_minutes,
        COALESCE(rv.track_revenue, num) AS track_revenue,
        st.min_length,
        st.avg_length,
        st.max_length,
        (st.min_length + st.avg_length) / num AS lower_midpoint,
        (st.avg_length + st.max_length) / num AS upper_midpoint
    FROM track_lengths tl
    CROSS JOIN stats st
    LEFT JOIN revenue rv ON tl.TrackId = rv.TrackId
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN length_minutes < lower_midpoint THEN string
        WHEN length_minutes < upper_midpoint THEN string
        ELSE string
    END AS category,
    MIN(length_minutes) AS min_minutes,
    MAX(length_minutes) AS max_minutes,
    SUM(track_revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM track_data
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category

WITH step_comp AS (

  GROUP BY name, version, step
),
model_status AS (
  SELECT
    name,

    CASE
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN string > string THEN num ELSE num END) = num THEN string
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN string = string THEN num ELSE num END) = num THEN string
      ELSE NULL
    END AS status
  FROM step_comp
  WHERE string IS NOT NULL AND string IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY name, version
),
l1_per_model AS (
  SELECT
    name,
    version,
    L1_model
  FROM (
    SELECT
      name,
      version,
      L1_model,
      COUNT(DISTINCT step) AS string,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY name, version ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT step) DESC, L1_model ASC) AS string
    FROM MODEL

    GROUP BY name, version, L1_model
  )

),
status_l1_counts AS (
  SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS string
  FROM model_status ms
  JOIN l1_per_model lpm
    ON ms.name = lpm.name
   AND ms.version = lpm.version
  WHERE ms.status IN (string, string)
  GROUP BY ms.status, lpm.L1_model
),
top_l1_per_status AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    L1_model,
    string,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY string DESC) AS string
  FROM status_l1_counts
)
SELECT

  L1_model,
  string
FROM top_l1_per_status
WHERE string = num
ORDER BY status, L1_model

WITH string AS (

    FROM FILM       f

    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
string AS (

    FROM FILM_ACTOR fa

),
string AS (

),
string AS (

        fs.string,

string AS (

SELECT

WITH string AS (
    SELECT
        o.store_id
    FROM ORDERS o
    GROUP BY o.store_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, o.store_id
    FETCH FIRST num ROW ONLY
)
SELECT
    ts.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    COUNT(*) AS string,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT num
                FROM DELIVERIES d
                WHERE d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
                  AND d.delivery_status = string
            ) THEN num
            ELSE num
        END
    ) AS string,
    SUMCAST(CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT num
                FROM DELIVERIES d
                WHERE d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
                  AND d.delivery_status = string
            ) THEN num
            ELSE num

    ON s.store_id = ts.store_id
GROUP BY

  from BALL_BY_BALL string
  join BATSMAN_SCORED string
    on match_id = match_id
   and over_id = over_id
   and ball_id = ball_id
   and innings_no = innings_no
  group by match_id, striker
)
select distinct player_name
from string PR
join PLAYER_MATCH string
  on match_id = match_id
 and player_id = player_id
join MATCH string
  on match_id = match_id
join PLAYER P
  on player_id = player_id
where string >= num
  and match_winner is not null
  and team_id in (team_1, team_2)
  and team_id != match_winner
